'''Tyler Christopher Nickel''' (born September 5, 2003) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]], [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]] and for the [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores]].

==Early life and high school==
Nickel attended [[East Rockingham High School]] located in [[Elkton, Virginia]]. As a [[Junior (education year)|junior]], he averaged 33.7 points, 10.1 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 1.6 steals per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Fowler |first1=Chapel |title=Will UNC basketball land 4-star 2022 forward Tyler Nickel this week? Experts say yes |url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/09/14/unc-tar-heels-basketball-hubert-davis-tyler-nickel-recruiting-4-star-east-rockingham-high-school/8338576002/ |website=The Fayetteville Observer |date=14 September 2021 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> Coming out of high school, Nickel was rated as a four-star recruit by 247Sports, where he held offers from schools such as Butler, LSU, North Carolina, and Virginia Tech.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Fowler |first1=Chapel |title=UNC basketball enters an either-or situation with two 2022 recruits. How will the Tar Heels handle it? |url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2021/09/02/unc-basketball-recruiting-2022-cam-whitmore-tyler-nickel/5647918001/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=true&gca-epti=z113214e006200v113214d--35--b--35--&gca-ft=194&gca-ds=sophi |website=The Fayetteville Observer |date=2 September 2021 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> Ultimately, he committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Eck |first1=TJ |title=Nickel officially signs with UNC |url=https://www.whsv.com/2021/11/10/nickel-officially-signs-with-unc/ |website=WHSV.com |date=10 November 2021 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>

==College career==
=== North Carolina ===
As a [[freshman]] during the 2022-23 season, Nickel played in 25 games, averaging 2.1 points and 0.6 rebounds per game. After the conclusion of the season, he entered the NCAA transfer portal.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pearson |first1=Zack |title=Former UNC forward drawing interest in transfer portal |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/former-unc-forward-drawing-interest-022513103.html |website=Yahoo Sports |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>

=== Virginia Tech ===
Nickel transferred to play for the [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Tipton |first1=Joe |title=North Carolina transfer Tyler Nickel commits to Virginia Tech |url=https://www.on3.com/college/virginia-tech-hokies/news/north-carolina-transfer-tyler-nickel-commits-to-virginia-tech/ |website=On3.com |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> On January 10, 2024, he dropped 24 points and five three-pointers, in a victory versus [[2023–24 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Haren |first1=Jarvis |title=East Rockingham grad Tyler Nickel shines in Virginia Tech win over No. 21 Clemson |url=https://www.whsv.com/2024/01/11/east-rockingham-grad-tyler-nickel-shines-virginia-tech-win-over-no-21-clemson/ |website=WHSV.com |date=11 January 2024 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> Nickel finished the 2023-24 season, appearing in 33 games with seven starts, averaging 8.8 points, 2.2 rebounds, and 1.3 assists per game. After the conclusion of the season, he once again entered the NCAA transfer portal.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Haren |first1=Jarvis |title=REPORT: East Rock grad Nickel to enter transfer portal |url=https://www.whsv.com/2024/03/29/report-east-rock-grad-nickel-enter-transfer-portal/ |website=WHSV.com |date=29 March 2024 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Gershon |first1=Aaron |title=Kentucky in contact with Virginia Tech transfer Tyler Nickel |url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/article/tyler-nickel-kentucky-wildcats-transfer-portal-229737372/ |website=247Sports |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>
